integrity: Full exact Bernoulli/conditional geometric proof, curvature-coordinate computation, smallest-graph classification, and standalone finite rational/SymPy verification. No claim of independent validation.
scientific_limitations: One absorbing vertex, finite connected simple undirected graph, strictly positive symmetric edge weights, full first-hitting-time observation, interior parameters. The rank-two Fisher metric is standard expected score outer product, without a factor of four. Exact sharp minimality is for nonflat two-dimensional full-law Fisher information; no global curvature classification beyond four vertices or multi-target models is claimed. General zero-inflated geometric Fisher likelihoods predate this work. The graph-specific historical priority is assessed from accessible sources only and is not independently certified.
title: The smallest nonflat Fisher geometry of an absorbing reversible random walk
